g.text: Original-role probabilities across the target body
All traces · secondary cohort · n = 57 | 20 equal relative-position bins per body
Shading: pointwise 95% paired trace-bootstrap intervals; 2,000 resamples. Empty bins remain missing.
Tokens are averaged within each trace/bin before traces are weighted equally. Curves describe relative body position, not absolute trace position.
